eyebrow: Lineage view — where governance sees the whole chain
caption: Every workspace's automatic lineage diagram: data sources, semantic models, reports, and dashboards connected left to right.
Selecting one artifact highlights everything upstream and downstream of it — exactly the question a governance review needs answered.
A card's impact-analysis icon opens the next question lineage can't fully answer on its own: who actually depends on this?
Impact analysis counts every impacted child item and workspace before you ever touch the dataset.

eyebrow: Warning owners before you change anything
caption: One click notifies every contact across every impacted workspace — including ones you don't have access to yourself.

subtitle: Lineage shows what's connected. Usage shows what's actually used.
